g.text: Seven percentage questions: private revision versus chat, with individual or group incentives.
All dashed lines show private estimates BEFORE discussion; solid lines show the subsequent individual answers.
Gurcay, Mellers & Baron (2015) | doi.org/10.1002/bdm.1843 | Data: Almaatouq et al. repository
Reference = 5 initial reports in the same condition. Some original groups have only 7 paired responses, so k stops at 7.
Control uncertainty resamples 92 independent people; chat uncertainty resamples 10 intact groups per incentive condition.
Every facet uses its own initial reference. Dashed = before feedback; solid = after revision.
k counts reports sampled from existing groups. It is not the number of participants needed to run the social experiment.
